cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

standard.scope: Shell boot, disk HELLO, CAT/WC pipeline and EXIT

limits: Production adds desktop, terminal, stream backend and two shell sessions, replacing the GF0 controller/heartbeat topology.
The native command uses D8 rather than GF0 D1 and no AES registration; it offers the same four 16 KiB read/verify/write/Close passes.
Observer/menu/screenshot settlement contributes to both enclosing windows; these intervals are not command-only throughput comparisons.
The paced eight-pixel pointer sample includes physical packet scheduling and is not per-transition IL3 latency.
Whole-production-disk CPU totals were not captured. GF0 retains only a separately scoped disk CPU prefix; no full-run CPU speedup is claimed.

profile_delta_from_non_sdx_control.reason: Existing SDX support is enabled by default in SIO distributions; this is not new GUI storage.

corrections: SYS staging and refresh include the ABI-matched Terminal APP.
QED provider budgeting counts the existing shared four code/table banks once, with unchanged explicit allowances.
Task census includes the dedicated console backend; eight boot Tasks and twelve in the combined case are observed.
Standalone demo pixels read the presentation copy and saved OS snapshot.
Session observer waits for Terminal input binding and painted selection before typing.
Shutdown observer exits both created sessions before expecting final system return.
Cancellation uses a separate cold read-only input and requires the native warning (5,304), preserving the normal write-result file.

retained_failures.scope: Runtime/QED/two-session EXIT/ownership passed, but disk audit rejected empty RESULT.BIN. The cancellation probe reused an output-producing command and did not prove read-only cancellation. Replaced by a cold read-only source with explicit (5,304) warning and full persisted-byte audit.
All combined functional phases through QED passed; observer sent E before Terminal rebound after SESSION 2 and timed out. Replaced by binding-aware focused and full walks.
An earlier observer exited only one of two sessions before waiting for final shutdown. No product shutdown failure is inferred.

open_limits: Development checks only; full hosted-system/release qualification and physical hardware remain separate.
Existing failed interaction latency gates remain open; their original protocols were not rerun or relaxed.
GF14 retains existing drawing boundaries; the 32-row trial is not in the delivered package.
QED coverage here is the focused changed-window/terminal coexistence walk, not a new full editor qualification.
Touched-byte stack watermarks are lower bounds on reserved stack depth; C frame reservations are not all written.
